prompts.FireBrush: Use case: game-asset. Asset type: a single Unity VFX brush particle/ribbon texture, full RGBA TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Primary request: A tall vermilion-flame-shaped but MONOCHROME brush silhouette: a broad central body at top splitting into three or four long sharp ragged branches toward bottom, large jagged outer silhouette, no tiny scattered specks. Style: hand-painted Korean ink and flat watercolour with drybrush texture, BLACK ink contour and WHITE opaque wash body only. A neutral luminance mask, NO actual coloured pixels, no gray backdrop. White body is visible opaque paint, not a cutout. Subtle transparent bristle gaps, black ink stays black when multiplied by tint. Composition: exactly ONE isolated vertical motif, centered, fills 80% height, ample transparent padding on all four sides, 2:3 or square texture. Top +Y is forward, bottom trails backward. No paper, no text, no letters, no labels, no orb, no shadow, no glow, no fake checkerboard, no background.
